name: @canvist/canvas
description: canvist's design canvas for the browser: shapes, frames, images, vector paths, and text frames on the real canvist editor, rendered by vello on WebGPU with a CPU fallback, and collaborative.

scripts.build:wasm: cd ../.. && wasm-pack build crates/canvist_canvas_wasm --target web --release --out-dir ../../packages/canvist-canvas/wasm --no-pack && rm packages/canvist-canvas/wasm/.gitignore
